comparison.objective: Place a saucepan on a burner with its handle safely turned over the counter; candidate tunes an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Vessel placement and final yaw orientation versus hex-tool alignment, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and set-screw locking.
comparison.success_condition: Pan is supported on the burner with handle in the safe region versus two validated non-bottoming stops. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Safe cookware placement is not mechanical commissioning.
